chung.Syllabus Name: Programming Fundamentals (with C/C++)_Cơ sở lập trình (với C/C++)
chung.Learning-Teaching Method: Social Constructivism, Inquiry-Based Learning, In-class lecture, Active Learning, Project-based learning
chung.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 1h final exam + 85' practical exam + 4.5h final project presentation + 98.1h self-study
chung.Description: This course equips students with knowledge of the C/C++ programming language from basic to advanced. Basics: C/C++ Keywords, C/C++ Variable Types, Lvalues and Rvalues, Operators in C/C++, Strings, Arrays, Pointers, C/C++ References, C/C++ Basic Input/Output, OOP. Advance: C/C++ Standard Template Libraries, Files/streaming, Exception, template, multithread, smartpointer, etc. Skill: Problem-solving thinking skills, logical thinking and technical communication skills in the direction of Computational Thinking (CT).
chung.StudentTasks:
- Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.
- Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time
- Students apply Computational Thinking (CT) to analyze, model, and present solutions to problems
- Use laptop in class only for learning purpose
- Promptly access to the FU FLM at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information

clo: Understand and apply fundamental concepts in C/C++ programming, including C/C++ keywords, variable types, Lvalues and Rvalues, operators, strings, arrays, and pointers.
Implement decision-making constructs (if-else, switch), loops (for, while, do-while), and modify program flow using control flow keywords (break, continue, goto).
Define, declare, and implement functions in C/C++, using modular programming techniques such as recursion, function pointers, and parameter passing.

Understand and apply object-oriented programming (OOP) principles like encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism. Use pointers, references, dynamic memory allocation, and smart pointers in C++ for efficient memory management. Avoid memory leaks and dangling pointers while working with classes, constructors, destructors, templates, and exceptions.
Open, read, write, and close files using C/C++ file handling functions and streams. Distinguish between binary and text file formats and perform random access operations.
Use AI Tools and Computational Thinking (CT) tools to identify, analyze, model, and demonstrate problem-solving
danhGia: The examination is conducted by the exam board. A minimum of two teachers is required for grading the Final Project. Each team is allocated 30 minutes for the presentation of their project followed by a Q&A session. Evaluation of the final presentation is based on the final report, project demonstration, and Q&A interaction. The grade is determined by averaging the grades given by the teachers.

ghiChuKiemChung: Syllabus gốc có chỗ nhiệm vụ KHÔNG khớp chủ đề buổi: buổi 41 'Polymorphism' ghi nhiệm vụ 'Implement constructors and destructors'; buổi 42 'Exceptions' ghi 'Implement scope control in classes'; buổi 43 'Data Structures and STL' ghi 'Implement inheritance in classes'. Giữ nguyên bảng gốc, nêu rõ chỗ lệch cho sinh viên, KHÔNG tự sửa.
Buổi 34-36 gắn CLO3 nhưng nội dung là OOP (thuộc CLO4 theo bảng CLO) — trường đánh nhãn vậy.
Pre-Requisite để TRỐNG trên FLM (không ghi 'None') — nói rõ là trường không công bố, đừng suy diễn.
